analysis.purpose: Validate and normalize assay tables into a stable tidy schema.
workflow: Validate required identifiers, values, and units before writing any output.
Map supported column aliases into the canonical assay schema without guessing ambiguous fields.
Normalize values and units deterministically while preserving assay and sample identity.
Write the normalized table and a machine-readable transformation summary.

caveats.text: Declared units describe comparable assay measurements and are not inferred from the numeric values.
The skill normalizes supported schemas and units; it does not interpret assay quality or biological significance.
Ambiguous aliases must be resolved by the user rather than guessed from column position or example fixtures.

description: Use to validate and normalize assay tables into a stable tidy schema.

reject_if: A required assay or sample identifier is absent or ambiguous.
A measurement is non-finite or its unit is missing or unsupported.
requirements: Provide one CSV assay table with assay ID, sample ID, numeric value, and unit columns or declared aliases.
Use supported explicit measurement units; do not rely on value-based unit inference.
input.summary: One delimited assay table containing stable assay and sample identifiers, numeric measurements, and explicit units.

objective: Normalize supported assay-table aliases and units without silently guessing ambiguous columns.
starting_prompt: Normalize this assay table into the canonical tidy schema.
